context: Asuka gives Ren feedback on a draft.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic feedback; vocabulary (著作/参照/疑問/賞/与える) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良く書けています。賞を狙えますよ。
lines.en: Well written. You could aim for an award.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm encouraging clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本当ですか?疑問もありますが。
lines.style: surprised young student voice, soft warm earnest throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その疑問を、結論で与えるといいですね。
lines.en: It's good to pose that question in your conclusion.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 参照が、足りないでしょうか?
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もう一つ、著作を参照しましょう。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: どの著作を、参照すべきですか?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古典が、深みを与えてくれますよ。
lines.en: The classics will give it depth.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 疑問を大切に、書き直します。
lines.en: Valuing the question, I'll rewrite it.
lines.style: resolved young student voice, soft warm appreciative closing throughout
